mapper.select: SELECT u.USER_ID AS userId, u.B_AMOUNT AS budget, COALESCE(SUM(m.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT), 0) AS spent FROM USERS u JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION) p ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN MYTRANS m ON m.USER_ID = u.USER_ID AND m.TYPE = 'OUT' AND COALESCE(m.EXCLUDE_ANALYSIS, 'N') = 'N' AND m.TRANS_DATE >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AND m.TRANS_DATE < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' WHERE u.STATUS = 'Y' AND u.B_AMOUNT IS NOT NULL AND u.B_AMOUNT > 0 GROUP BY u.USER_ID, u.B_AMOUNT HAVING COALESCE(SUM(m.ORIGINAL_AMOUNT), 0) > u.B_AMOUNT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUDGET_ALERT_LOG (USER_ID, YEAR_MONTH) VALUES (#{userId}, #{yearMonth}) ON CONFLICT (USER_ID, YEAR_MONTH) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT f.USER_ID AS userId, f.NAME AS name, f.AMOUNT AS amount FROM FIXEDTRANS f JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT USER_ID FROM PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION) p ON p.USER_ID = f.USER_ID WHERE f.PAY_DAY = EXTRACT(DAY FROM (CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'))
